title: 广告、时间表、收据
goal: 在广告、时间表和收据中定位数字，并合并优惠、期限及例外条件。

points.label: 在表格和列表中找到对应的数字、时间
合并两处信息并核对条件、例外

cards.title: 结构
rows: 先确定服务或商品，再读对应价格。
先找日期所在的行，再读起止时间。
分清数量、单价和这一行的小计。
先确定优惠用在哪一项，再加上不打折的费用。
分清总价、已付金额和还要付的金额。
把条件和价格所在的行合起来读。
Small lockers $3. Large lockers $5. Coupon: small lockers only.

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: 只在所写的条件下有效。
The voucher is valid only on weekdays.
后面所说的时段或对象除外。
所列金额不含后面的项目。
表示上限，最多到这个数。
Discounts of up to 20% are available.
表示计价单位，总价要按数量相乘。
The charge is $8 per box per day.
from…to… 是时间段，after 只给起点。
Open from 9 to 5. Collections begin after 1.
表示减去的金额或比例。
10% off a $40 item reduces the price to $36.

body.box:
TENT HIRE
Small tent: $20 per day
Large tent: $35 per day
Weekend voucher: 10% off tent hire, valid only for bookings of at least two days
Delivery: $8 per order, excluded from discounts

What is the total for a small tent hired for two weekend days with the voucher and delivery?
1. $40.00
2. $43.20
3. $44.00
4. $48.00

body.p: 先找 Small tent 的单价：$20 per day。租 2 天，租金为 $40。租期满足 at least two days 的条件。
优惠只用于租金：$40 × 90% = $36。再加上不打折的 $8 运费，总价为 $44，即第三项。第二项把运费也打了折，第四项漏了优惠。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: A two-day small tent rental costs $20.
per day 是每天的价格，要乘以天数。
The voucher applies to a one-day booking.
at least two days 要求不少于 2 天。
excluded from discounts 说明运费不打折。
Every item marked up to 20% off gets 20% off.

groups.label: Read the notice.
groups.text:
TOOL SHARPENING
Kitchen knives: $6 each
Garden shears: $9 each
Collection service: $4 per order

items.stem: What is the sharpening charge for one pair of garden shears?
items.why: 依据是 Garden shears: $9 each，即第二项。上门取件的 $4 另算。

groups.label: Read the notice.
groups.text:
COMMUNITY SAUNA
Monday–Friday: 7 a.m.–9 p.m.
Saturday: 10 a.m.–4 p.m.
Sunday: 10 a.m.–1 p.m.

items.stem: When does the sauna close on Sunday?
items.why: 依据是 Sunday: 10 a.m.–1 p.m.，下午 1 点对应 early afternoon。

groups.label: Read the notice.
groups.text:
CUSHION COVERS
Standard cover: $12
Voucher: $3 off each standard cover, valid only for purchases of at least two covers

items.stem: What is the cost of one standard cover?
items.why: 依据是 valid only for purchases of at least two covers。只买 1 个不能用优惠，按原价 $12，即第四项。

groups.label: Read the notice.
groups.text:
COAT CLEANING RECEIPT
Cleaning total: $28
Amount already paid: $10
Balance due at collection

items.stem: How much remains to be paid?
items.why: 依据是 Cleaning total: $28 和 Amount already paid: $10，余额为 $28 − $10 = $18。

groups.label: Read the notice.
groups.text:
Fruit Press Booking
Morning slot: 9 a.m.–noon, $24
Afternoon slot: 1 p.m.–4 p.m., $30
Cleaning charge: $6 per booking
Cooperative members receive $4 off the slot price. The cleaning charge is not discounted. Collection is available only during the booked slot.

items.stem: When does the afternoon slot begin?
items.why: 依据是 Afternoon slot: 1 p.m.–4 p.m.，下午时段从 1 点开始，即第三项。

items.stem: What does a member pay for a morning booking including cleaning?
items.why: 依据是 Morning slot 的 $24、$4 off the slot price 和 Cleaning charge: $6，总价为 $24 − $4 + $6 = $26。

groups.label: Read the notice.
groups.text:
STATION LUGGAGE STORE
Storage rates per bag
Small bag: $4 for up to 3 hours; $7 for more than 3 hours
Large bag: $6 for up to 3 hours; $10 for more than 3 hours
Opening times
Monday–Friday: 7 a.m.–8 p.m.
Saturday–Sunday: 9 a.m.–6 p.m.
Advance-booking offer: $1 off each small bag stored for more than 3 hours. The offer excludes large bags. All bags must be collected before closing on the same day.

items.stem: What is the standard rate for a large bag stored for two hours?
items.why: 依据是 Large bag: $6 for up to 3 hours。2 小时在 3 小时以内，即第二项。

items.stem: When does the store close on Saturday?
items.why: 依据是 Saturday–Sunday: 9 a.m.–6 p.m.，周末晚上 6 点关门，即第一项。

items.stem: What does an advance booking for one small bag stored for four hours cost?
items.why: 依据是 small bag 的 $7 for more than 3 hours 和 $1 off each small bag，费用为 $7 − $1 = $6。

groups.label: Read the notice.
groups.text:
MAPLE ALTERATIONS — RECEIPT 62
Trouser hems: 2 pairs × $15 = $30
Jacket sleeve adjustment: $24
Voucher: 20% off trouser hems only = −$6
Total: $48
Deposit paid: $18
Balance due: $30
Collection: Thursday after 3 p.m.
Thursday opening hours: 10 a.m.–7 p.m.
The voucher excludes jacket alterations. Collection requires this receipt. Items collected by another person also require written permission from the customer.

items.stem: How much was charged for the jacket sleeve adjustment?
items.why: 依据是 Jacket sleeve adjustment: $24，即第三项。

items.stem: What is the earliest listed collection time on Thursday?
options: After the shop opens at ten
After the shop closes at seven
At any time the shop is open
items.why: 依据是 Collection: Thursday after 3 p.m.，即第二项。10 a.m. 是开门时间，不是取件时间。

items.stem: What must a friend bring when collecting the order?
options: The receipt and written permission from the customer
The voucher and a new deposit for the jacket
The receipt and a payment of the full original price
The voucher and the customer's unaltered trousers
items.why: 依据是 Collection requires this receipt 和 also require written permission from the customer。第一项写出了代领要带的两样东西。
